question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Glorious
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Glorious **means having great beauty, splendor, or magnificence.(शानदार)

 
 
• **Example: **"The sunset painted the sky in glorious shades of red and orange."
 
 
 
• **Splendid** means magnificent, impressive, or excellent.(शानदार)
 
 
• **Example:** "They threw a splendid party to celebrate their anniversary."
 
 
 
• Hence, The correct synonym is **'Splendid.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 4.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Option 1) Immense** (अत्यधिक) - This word means extremely large or vast in size, which is not synonymous with "glorious."
 
• **Option 2) Dull** (उबाऊ) **-** Dull means lacking interest or excitement, which is the opposite of "glorious."
 
• **Option 3) Keen** (तीव्र) - Keen means having a sharp intellect or enthusiastic, but it doesn't convey the idea of grandeur or magnificence implied by "glorious."
